issues.body: The round-one blocker is unchanged: `matches!(result, Err(...))` matches `result` by value and consumes the non-Copy `Result<Ontology, ExtractError>`. The following `assert!` formats `result` with `{:?}`, producing E0382 (borrow of moved value). Assigning the match outcome to `ok` does not preserve `result`, so the integration test target still fails to compile with default features and with `dl_datatypes`.
issues.fix_hint: Match by reference in both cfg arms: `matches!(&result, Err(ExtractError::Unclassifiable(_)))` and `matches!(&result, Err(ExtractError::DataConstruct(_)))`. Then run the extract integration test both with default features and with `--features dl_datatypes`.
issues.title: Feature-dependent refusal helper still moves its Result

verdict.summary: Round 2 remains blocked by the same compile error identified in round 1. The helper now stores the match result in `ok`, but both cfg-selected `matches!(result, ...)` expressions still consume the non-Copy `Result`; the subsequent assertion diagnostic still borrows `result`. Thus the extract integration test target cannot compile in either feature state. No instruction-like prompt injection was detected in the diff.
